messages:
Aisha: Morning — quick coordination for final SRE onsite (Tue 10:00 PT). Need a scribe + accessibility support (live captioning) :calendar:.
Priya: I can scribe. I'll take notes and upload to the candidate folder.
Jordan: Heads-up I have a partial conflict at 10:30. Can I still run the debrief at 11? :thinking:
Aisha: Yes — plan is quick debrief at 10:45 for 20m. If Jordan can join at 11 we can do a brief sync; otherwise Priya pls capture highlights.
Marco: Quick rubric question: how do we weight "on-call" vs "infra automation" for this role? The draft rubric has both at 20% but our hiring lead suggested infra heavier.
Samir: We bumped infra to 30% last hiring cycle for Sr SRE. Here's the snippet we used:
```
Experience weighting:
- Infra automation: 30
- On-call & incident handling: 25
- Design & systems: 25
- Communication & blamelessness: 20
```
Aisha: Thanks Samir. Hiring lead wants infra 35 / on-call 25 / others same. @Marco is that ok for this hire?
Marco: Fine by me. Just want to ensure interviewers know to probe automation depth (CI, infra-as-code, runbook dev).
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: please confirm accommodations 48h prior. Use the candidate accommodations form: https://intra.redwood.com/accomms
Priya: Will add a short template to the notes: candidate-summary + rubric-scores + top-3 red flags / strengths.
Aisha: Also need room setup: A/V for captions + Zoom link. CalendarBot: Created event "Final SRE Onsite" Tue 10:00 PT — Zoom + Room B (link).
Jordan: I'll try to join 10:45 for debrief. If not, I'll add comments to the doc within 2 hours.
Priya: Copy. I'll ping panel a 15m pre-brief to align on probing areas.
Aisha: Awesome — thanks everyone. If anyone needs to swap scribe ping me ASAP. :thumbsup:
